events.name: Sockeye Salmon Run
events.description: Spawning sockeye turn the river red. Dominant-year runs are an order of magnitude larger than off years. Underway — roughly 13% through the typical window, with 8 reports in the last two weeks.

events.name: Gerewol
events.description: Wodaabe men dance the yaake in ochre and beads for hours in the heat, judged by women of the clan. Held where herding groups converge as the rains end. Nomadic and weather-dependent — the gathering point shifts year to year, so coordinates are country-level on purpose.

sources.name: UNESCO ICH nomination context
sources.note: Attend only with Wodaabe hosts or the specialist operators who arrange with them. No fixed public venue exists.
